imports.application_premises: E is locally compact, separable and sigma-compact; nu is Radon and hence sigma-finite. A Poisson random measure exists, e.g. by independent finite Poisson pieces on a compact exhaustion.

consumed.application: Equality of Laplace functionals determines a point-process law.
Poisson characterization by its exponential Laplace functional for s-finite intensity.

imports.source: Last and Penrose, Lectures on the Poisson Process, version21 August2017

imports.application_premises: Proper closed embedding E=R^4 x(S1)^3 intoR10 via logarithmic regular coordinates. Compact ambient tests restrict to compact E tests. Both process and limiting intensity are supported on the closed copy. Vague topology returns to E by compact-support extension from this closed copy. Weak convergence is used in the standard bounded-continuous-functional sense.

consumed.application: Laplace convergence on nonnegative compact continuous Euclidean tests implies weak convergence of point processes in the vague topology.

imports.source: Bovier, From spin glasses to branching Brownian motion and back, Prague2013 notes
imports.source_note: Printed Definition4.10 on the same page leaves the bounded qualifier unstated for continuous functionals. This review uses the usual weak topology and Theorem4.11, not convergence of arbitrary unbounded functional expectations.
